openai-public: Bearer, store:false, public field/event admission; reasoning off maps to none.
Public WebSocket omits stream/background; exact owner continuation, socket lifecycle and HTTP fallback remain separately tested.
codex-http-relay: HTTP only; omit service_tier; admit only the frozen nonsemantic relay diagnostics.
Reconstruct contiguous completed Items only after valid terminal commit if terminal output is empty/absent; semantic-subset terminal output retains fuller completed Items.
codex-beta-2026-02-06: HTTP uses public request shape; WebSocket uses openai-beta: responses_websockets=2026-02-06 plus stream:true/stream_options.
No private Codex identity, attestation, x-codex headers or session/thread identifiers. Native web search is not admitted.
mimo-subset-2026-07-30: HTTP only; Bearer or x-api-key; no remote compact or continuation.
reasoning_text family; off→none and xhigh/max→high; empty summary placeholder only, reject encrypted reasoning.
deepseek-subset-2026-07-31: HTTP/Bearer only; exact model pair deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro.
No WebSocket/remote compact/continuation; plaintext reasoning_text; medium/xhigh→high, max→max.
deepseek-subset-2026-08-19: Preserves July subset restrictions and model pair; additionally admits native web search.
Search-coupled encrypted reasoning token stays opaque; toggle-off or non-admitting profile degrades the entire native batch to portable text.
Audit query normalization may remove documented ws_call_id transport artifacts; raw native call Items remain replay authority.

crossCutting: Cancellation interrupts requests/backoff; no implicit replay of committed user-visible output.
Generic adapter retries and Responses stream attempt retries have separate bounded contracts; do not multiply nested retry counts.
Provider proxy explicit/file/env precedence and redaction apply to HTTP and WebSocket; MCP/Tavily/Skill downloads do not inherit it.
Provider-owned opaque/signature/encrypted data must remain exact; normalization never strips it to obtain equality.
MCP dual-era behavior is a distinct tool/service matrix; no stdio transport is implied.
unsupportedCombinations: responsesProfile or responsesTransport on non-Responses protocol
WebSocket on codex-http-relay or dated subsets
remoteCompact on MiMo or DeepSeek subsets
Responses x-goog-api-key; Responses x-api-key except MiMo
DeepSeek subset models outside the declared pair
Native search on Chat Completions, Anthropic, Codex profiles or frozen July subsets
